J.League Winning Goal.name: J.League Winning Goal
J.League Winning Goal.summary: J.League Winning Goal is a soccer game released for the Game Boy and Family Computer that revolves around the J-League. There is an exhibition, a season mode, a playoff mode, and a practice mode. The object in the game is to win the championship so that the player's chosen team can be called the greatest team in all of Japan.

Pinball Mania.name: Pinball Mania
Pinball Mania.summary: This is a Game Boy port of Pinball Mania that was only released in the UK.

Ultraman Chou Toushi Gekiden.name: Ultraman: Chou Toushi Gekiden
Ultraman Chou Toushi Gekiden.summary: Ultraman: Chou Toushi Gekiden is an Action game, published by Angel (Bandai), which was released in Japan in 1994. Based on the Ultraman series. this game has you do everything from platfomring to side scroll shooting
